Comisión Europea, Agri-food Data Portal:.en: European Commission, Agri-food Data Portal: weekly price of rapeseed in Spain (national average, ex-silo farmer), EUR/tonne. It is not the EU average nor the Euronext future. The API does not publish a release date: the day the figure was first retrieved is recorded.
Comisión Europea, Agri-food Data Portal:.fr: Commission européenne, portail de données agroalimentaires (Agri-food Data Portal) : prix hebdomadaire du colza en Espagne (moyenne nationale, départ silo de l'agriculteur), EUR/tonne.
